scope: read-only review of final source and independent isolated/runtime fault processes; no second-agent assertion
proofFileChecks: Only script-created numeric staging paths accepted; /tmp/base/history opened with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW
Child lookups anchored to open directory descriptors; regular single-link proof inputs all validated before mutation
Actual runtime numeric UID/GID, matching directory ownership/mode0700, and final proof mode0600 enforced
FDs closed on every exit; symlinks/hardlinks/nonregular/missing inputs rejected without outside mutation
maintenanceChecks: Explicit maintenance and single-instance/exclusive-writer acknowledgement required
Exactly one original non-oneoff app; trusted image/User/project labels and matching mount metadata
Atomic project-named reservation; failed creation cleanup removes only matching owner label; existing reservation never removed
Other connected source PG clients rejected after app stop; disconnected/external writers require operator exclusion
Original container ID restarted with original CMD/config; initially stopped app remains stopped
INT/TERM/HUP route through EXIT; restart failure bounded and not retried blindly
Proof/journal still-current checks unchanged; success marker set while source remains held
Intermediate target output private until successful release; source restart failure removes marker and retains private diagnostics
limitations: Single Compose instance/exclusive window, not a cross-host or arbitrary replica lock
Catchable signals only; SIGKILL/host crash may require manual removal/recovery of owned reservation and original service
